NHA directly develops using government budget, targeting informal settlers and low-income government employees. This is the definition of NHA direct production. Pag-IBIG direct purchase is financing for individual buyers to purchase from private developers, not NHA-built. NHA joint ventures partner with private developers but are not the only delivery method NHA uses. questions.explanation: CMP can target socialized or economic, but informal settlers are socialized housing beneficiaries. Economic would be middle-income, not informal settlers. The community is informal settlers, meaning they target socialized housing eligibility (low income). CMP is the delivery method (SHFC financing for collective land purchase). The classification is socialized, and the delivery is CMP, which enables in-situ development without relocation. Incorrect — Low-cost is industry-recognized but not a statutory classification. NHA would be direct production, not CMP. CMP is SHFC-administered. Incorrect — Informal settlers are not open-market; Pag-IBIG direct purchase is for individual buyers purchasing completed units, not for community land acquisition. The community is informal settlers, meaning they target socialized housing eligibility (low income). CMP is the delivery method (SHFC financing for collective land purchase). The classification is socialized, and the delivery is CMP, which enables in-situ development without relocation. CMP is uniquely valuable for informal settlements because it enables in-place upgrading. The classification of the eventual housing depends on the community's income and the unit standards, but the delivery method is what makes CMP unique.

questions.text: Under BP 220, what are the minimum lot area and minimum floor area for an ECONOMIC housing SINGLE DETACHED unit?

options.text: Minimum lot area 64 sq m and minimum floor area 18 sq m
Minimum lot area 72 sq m and minimum floor area 22 sq m
Minimum lot area 28 sq m and minimum floor area 18 sq m
Minimum lot area 100 sq m and minimum floor area 30 sq m

rationale.a: Wrong. 64 sq m lot / 18 sq m floor is BP 220 SOCIALIZED housing single detached, not economic.
rationale.b: Correct. Per the BP 220 revised IRR, economic housing single detached requires a minimum 72 sq m lot and a minimum 22 sq m floor area.
rationale.c: Wrong. 28 sq m lot is BP 220 socialized rowhouse.
rationale.d: Wrong. 100 sq m lot / 30 sq m floor is PD 957 medium cost housing, not a BP 220 economic category.
rationale.correct: BP 220 revised IRR Table (minimum areas): economic housing single detached = 72 sq m lot, 22 sq m floor; economic duplex/single attached = 54 sq m lot, 22 sq m floor; economic rowhouse = 36 sq m lot, 22 sq m floor. Socialized housing figures are smaller (64/48/28 sq m lot; 18 sq m floor).
rationale.takeaway: BP 220 economic single detached is 72 sq m lot / 22 sq m floor. The 100 sq m figure belongs to PD 957 medium cost, not BP 220.
